sentences.en: He was still as still in the presence of danger.
sentences.zh: 他即使在面对危险时也依然保持冷静。

sentences.en: We shouted in order to warn everyone of the danger.
sentences.zh: 我们大声喊叫以警告大家有危险。

sentences.en: Red, as opposed to green, is a sign of danger.
sentences.zh: 红灯与绿灯相对，表示危险。

senses.zh: 危险，危险状态；威胁，可能造成危害的事物
